newsitem.title: USA: Texas January jobless rate at 5.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Texas January jobless rate at 5.4 pct.

text.p: The Texas unemployment rate rose 0.1 percent in January, with both the number of employed and the number of unemployed posting modest increases, the Texas Workforce Commission said this week.

Year to year the picture was brighter, with the number of unemployed Texans, seasonally adjusted, falling from 577,600 in January 1996 to 531,700 in January 1997, a drop of 45,900, the Commission said.

At a seasonally adjusted 5.4 percent, the January unemployment rate was still well below the year-ago rate of 6.0 percent. And, for the second consecutive month, the Texas rate was identical to the national rate.
